title: Latest F1 News
description: Don't miss a Formula 1 moment – with the latest news, videos, standings and results. Go behind the scenes and get analysis straight from the paddock.

items.title: Gasly charges to maiden F1 pole at Monza over Russell and Piastri
items.content: Alpine driver Pierre Gasly earned a brilliant first-ever F1 pole position at the Italian Grand Prix, edging out Mercedes’ George Russell and McLaren’s Oscar Piastri in a pulsating Qualifying session around the Autodromo Nazionale Monza.
items.contentSnippet: Alpine driver Pierre Gasly earned a brilliant first-ever F1 pole position at the Italian Grand Prix, edging out Mercedes’ George Russell and McLaren’s Oscar Piastri in a pulsating Qualifying session around the Autodromo Nazionale Monza.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利在意大利大奖赛蒙扎赛道上获得职业生涯首个F1杆位，他在紧张的排位赛中超越梅赛德斯的车手乔治·鲁塞尔和迈凯伦的车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
summaries.en: Pierre Gasly secured his first Formula 1 pole position at the Italian Grand Prix in Monza, surpassing Mercedes' George Russell and McLaren's Oscar Piastri during a competitive qualifying session.

items.title: ‘Who am I without racing?’ – Fewtrell on work with Quadrant
items.content: Former racing driver Max Fewtrell opens up about stepping away from the sport, building Quadrant and watching best friend Lando Norris become Formula 1 World Champion.
items.contentSnippet: Former racing driver Max Fewtrell opens up about stepping away from the sport, building Quadrant and watching best friend Lando Norris become Formula 1 World Champion.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 前赛车手马克斯·菲沃雷尔（Max Fewtrell）分享了他退出赛车界、创办Quadrant公司，以及见证好友兰多·诺里斯（Lando Norris）成为F1世界冠军的经历。他反思了离开赛车后的生活，并回顾了与Quadrant的合作历程。
summaries.en: Max Fewtrell, a former racing driver, discusses his transition from the sport to co-founding Quadrant. He reflects on watching his friend Lando Norris win the Formula 1 World Championship. The article highlights Fewtrell's journey beyond racing and his involvement in the business world.

items.title: When Schumacher retired after winning in front of the Tifosi
items.content: The Italian Grand Prix is home to the Tifosi – Ferrari’s passionate fan base – which made it the perfect place for Michael Schumacher to announce his first racing retirement 20 years ago.
items.contentSnippet: The Italian Grand Prix is home to the Tifosi – Ferrari’s passionate fan base – which made it the perfect place for Michael Schumacher to announce his first racing retirement 20 years ago.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 在意大利大奖赛，法拉利的忠实球迷Tifosi热情非凡，这也是迈克尔·舒马赫宣布首次赛车退役的完美地点。20年前，他在夺冠后向球迷致敬，正式宣告结束赛车生涯。
summaries.en: At the Italian Grand Prix, Michael Schumacher announced his first racing retirement before Ferrari's passionate Tifosi fans. The event marked a significant moment in his career.
